verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only event-driven automation: rules, webhooks, online evaluators that run on incoming production traces, and threshold alerts. None of these is a recurring, time-based schedule (cron-style jobs or workflows). Nothing in the pack documents scheduling a job or workflow to run on a recurring cadence, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
